source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("digital identity" OR "digital ID" OR "digital identification" OR "national ID" OR "national identity card" OR "national identity cards" OR "foundational ID" OR "identity cards" OR "ID cards" OR "identity documents") AND (citizenship OR welfare OR "social protection" OR surveillance OR "public services" OR "financial inclusion" OR government)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("digital identity" OR "digital ID" OR "digital identification" OR "national ID" OR "national identity card" OR "national identity cards" OR "foundational ID" OR "identity cards" OR "ID cards" OR "identity documents") AND (citizenship OR welfare OR "social protection" OR surveillance OR "public services" OR "financial inclusion" OR government),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("ID cards" OR "digital ID" OR "digital identification" OR "digital identity" OR "foundational ID" OR "identity cards" OR "identity documents" OR "national ID" OR "national identity card" OR "national identity cards") AND ("financial inclusion" OR "public services" OR "social protection" OR "citizenship" OR "government" OR "surveillance" OR "welfare"))
